ingameEffects.label: Eclipse Effect (W-Engine Passive)
ingameEffects.description: CRIT Rate increases by 20%. When the equipper is Pyrois, using an Ultimate grants the Eclipse effect. When the Eclipse effect is active, DMG dealt by the equipper ignores a percentage of Ether RES, lasting 45s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. When the equipper enters combat, they gain the Eclipse effect.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: Increases the equipper's CRIT Rate by 20%.
